definitions.gloss: even if, even though, no matter
definitions.explanation: Used to introduce a hypothetical or concessive condition, emphasizing that the outcome won't change regardless of the condition.

examples.english: Even if it rains, I will go.

examples.japanese: たとえ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{諦|あきら}めない→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧。
examples.english: Even if I fail, I won't give up.

examples.japanese: たとえ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかって→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦やり{遂|と}げる→やり遂げる：16745_yaritogeru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how long it takes, I will accomplish it.
Even if it's far, I'll go to see you.

examples.japanese: たとえ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}いかけたい→追いかける：16734_oikakeru⟧。
examples.english: Even if the people around me are against it, I want to pursue my dream.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- たとえ〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: Even if ~ (with te-form + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧)
- たとえ〜⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧: Even if ~ (with noun/na-adjective + ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧)
- たとえ〜⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: Even assuming that ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- たとえ: Even if (emphasizes hypothetical)
- ⟦もし→もし：01284_moshi⟧: If (neutral conditional)
- ⟦{仮|かり}に→仮に：07029_karini⟧: Supposing, even if (more formal)

NOTE: たとえ is typically paired with 〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧/〜⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧ to form the complete pattern. Using たとえ emphasizes the speaker's determination or that the condition doesn't matter.
